WITH transaction_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) as cross_region_average
  FROM transaction_regions
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM transaction_regions
  GROUP BY region
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    r.avg_amount,
    r.transaction_count,
    (r.avg_amount - o.cross_region_average) as above_average
  FROM region_stats r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE r.avg_amount > o.cross_region_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_amount) as avg_transaction_amount,
  AVG(transaction_count) as avg_transaction_count,
  AVG(above_average) as avg_above_cross_region
FROM filtered_regions;

assumptions.assumption: Transaction amounts are interpreted as unsigned (trans.amount values as stored in the database). Since trans.amount is stored unsigned with direction indicated separately in trans.type, "average transaction amount" could mean either the average magnitude or the average net value after applying transaction direction.

alternatives.interpretation: Apply signs to transaction amounts based on trans.type: PRIJEM (credit) adds the amount, VYDAJ (withdrawal) subtracts it, and VYBER (undocumented direction) is treated as unsigned. This yields average net transaction flow by region rather than average magnitude.

WITH transaction_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
      ELSE t.amount
    END as signed_amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(signed_amount) as cross_region_average
  FROM transaction_regions
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(signed_amount) as avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM transaction_regions
  GROUP BY region
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    r.avg_amount,
    r.transaction_count,
    (r.avg_amount - o.cross_region_average) as above_average
  FROM region_stats r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE r.avg_amount > o.cross_region_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_amount) as avg_transaction_amount,
  AVG(transaction_count) as avg_transaction_count,
  AVG(above_average) as avg_above_cross_region
FROM filtered_regions;
